aspect: Fees per person, per application, per cycle
description: Applications for leave to remain are charged per applicant, so a family of four pays four times, on a route that may require several grants before settlement. A health surcharge is levied on top, in advance, for the full period.
money_note: Per cycle, per family, plus surcharge in advance.
energy_note: Charged per head, per cycle, for a decade.

aspect: Missing a renewal converts lawful to unlawful overnight
description: A late application, often caused by not having the fee on the date, ends continuous residence and can reset a ten-year route to zero.
energy_note: Nine years of compliance, voided by one late payment.

aspect: Legal help is the difference and is not funded
description: The difference between a granted and refused application is frequently the quality of the submission. Representation costs money that the fees have already taken.
energy_note: Needing a lawyer you spent the lawyer's fee on the form.

aspect: SCENARIO - the family that split by arithmetic
description: Four applications, and enough money for three. They apply for the children and the mother. The father's leave lapses. He is now the one who cannot work, in the house he is paying for.
energy_note: A family made illegal by a budget.

description: The application is GBP 1,048 each plus the surcharge for three years, payable at submission, for four people. She works it out twice because the first total seemed wrong. It was not wrong.
energy_note: Four people, three years, paid in advance, in one transaction.
